name: PolynomialRing
summary: The ring of polynomials in one variable over R; P<x> := PolynomialRing(R) names its variable x.

examples.expected: Univariate Polynomial Ring in x over Integer Ring

Univariate Polynomial Ring in y over GF(3^2)
y^3 + y

differs: Polynomial rings over the integers, the rationals and finite fields only: over other rings, PolynomialRing is refused.

name: Roots
summary: The roots of a nonzero polynomial in its coefficient ring, as [<root, multiplicity>, ...].
differs: Polynomial rings over the integers, the rationals and finite fields only: over other rings, PolynomialRing is refused.
Over a finite field: a degree of at most 1000 (prime fields below 2^32), and smaller degrees in other fields (degree^3 times the bits of q at most 10^6), are factored; larger ones are refused.

name: Roots
summary: The roots of a nonzero polynomial in the ring R, with their multiplicities.
differs: R must be the integers or the rationals (for a polynomial over a finite field, its own field): roots in a real or complex field, another finite field or a number field are refused.

name: Degree
summary: The degree of a polynomial; -1 for the zero polynomial.

name: Coefficients
summary: The coefficients of f, constant term first; [] for the zero polynomial.

name: Coefficient
summary: The coefficient of x^i in f (0 beyond its degree).

name: LeadingCoefficient
summary: The coefficient of the highest power of a nonzero polynomial.

name: ChangeRing
summary: The univariate polynomial ring over R (the integers, the rationals or a finite field), and the map from P to it.

examples.expected:
Univariate Polynomial Ring over GF(5^2)
Mapping from: RngUPol: P to Univariate Polynomial Ring over GF(5^2)

differs: Only polynomial rings over the integers, the rationals and finite fields, to one of these rings: Integers(m), the reals and other rings are refused in words.

name: ChangeRing
summary: f with each coefficient coerced into R (Z, Q or a finite field): between finite fields into an overfield or a subfield.

examples.code: K<b> := GF(16); U<u> := PolynomialRing(K); F<a> := GF(4); ChangeRing(u^2 + b^5*u + 1, F);

differs: Work is bounded (prime-field coefficient operations, counted before any coefficient is coerced): past the bound, or between finite fields of more than 2^20 elements, it is refused in words.
Only polynomials over the integers, the rationals and finite fields, to one of these rings: Integers(m), the reals and other rings are refused in words.

name: Evaluate
summary: The value of the polynomial f at x.

name: Derivative
summary: The k-th derivative of a polynomial (k at least 0).
differs: A huge order k (10^12, say) is refused by Magma; Sagebrush returns 0 once the derivatives reach zero.

name: Discriminant
summary: The discriminant of a polynomial of degree at least 1.
differs: Refused for a polynomial over a finite field.

name: Resultant
differs: Refused for polynomials over a finite field.

name: IsIrreducible
summary: Whether a nonzero polynomial is irreducible over its coefficient ring (a constant never is).
differs: Over a finite field: a degree of at most 1000 (prime fields below 2^32), and smaller degrees in other fields (degree^3 times the bits of q at most 10^6), are factored; larger ones are refused.

name: Factorization
summary: The factorization of a nonzero polynomial into irreducibles, as [<factor, exponent>, ...], and its leading coefficient.

examples.code: K<w> := GF(4); R<y> := PolynomialRing(K); Factorization(y^4 - y);

differs: Polynomial rings over the integers, the rationals and finite fields only: over other rings, PolynomialRing is refused.
Over a finite field: a degree of at most 1000 (prime fields below 2^32), and smaller degrees in other fields (degree^3 times the bits of q at most 10^6), are factored; larger ones are refused.

name: Gcd
summary: The greatest common divisor of two polynomials (monic over the rationals).
